notes:
Deal summary: Stalled -> closed-lost due to strict EU-only data residency requirement. Aurora LegalTech (legal/process automation for mid-sized law firms) required a Private or Dedicated deployment that guarantees EU-only processing and storage (no control-plane egress).

Timeline (high level):
- 2024-07-02: Initial intro call (AE: Maya). good fit: contract review + redaction use cases, latency SLOs 100-200ms p95 for chat flows.
- 2024-07-15: Demo of hosted API and Dedicated deck. SE (Ravi) ran latency/cost estimates.
- 2024-08-02: Security questionnaire submitted (SaaS security pack + SOC2 asked).
- 2024-08-22: Fireflies transcript ff-20240822-review: security mentioned EU-only residency requirement multiple times (quote: "we cannot allow any customer data to leave EU borders, control plane included").
- 2024-09-03: On-site (virtual) architecture review. SE presented VPC options but unable to commit to EU-only private control plane under current roadmap.
- 2024-09-18: Procurement engaged; competitor (EUCloudAI) proposed managed EU-backed private deployment with local KMS and in-scope ISO attestation.
- 2024-09-20: Final call; Aurora signs with EUCloudAI. Redwood marked closed-lost.

Key requirements and constraints:
- Must be EU-only residency for both compute and control plane; legal/regulatory requirement from their jurisdiction.
- SSO (SAML), retention controls, audit logs, customer-managed KMS required.
- Latency target: p95 <= 200ms for 1K concurrent chat sessions (burst). Throughput 50 rps steady for batch scoring.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, looked for predictable committed spend (preferred annual).

Why we lost:
- Primary: Redwood could not guarantee EU-only control-plane and data residency at time of procurement (roadmap item but no firm timeline).
- Secondary: No internal champion after legal/infosec pushed for vendor with explicit EU hosting clause. Procurement also paused budget while evaluating hosted EU offer from competitor.

Sales notes / CRM fragments: 
- "They repeated: 'EU-only or nothing' — legal will not sign otherwise."
- SE did a thorough POC for contract redaction but final SOW blocked by residency clause.
- Procurement feedback: liked pricing and performance but legal risk unacceptable.
- Action: flag for Product Roadmap (customer escalation) and add to re-engage list if EU-only private/control-plane becomes available.

Next steps (post-lose):
- Close-won/closed-lost review completed 2024-10-05.
- Add to quarterly cadence for re-engagement (Q1 2025), notify AE/SE when EU-only option released.
- Keep architecture notes and security questionnaire for future fast follow.

Attachments & refs: pricing deck, security scan (drive links), fireflies call ids, support ticket RDW-1058 for KMS questions.
